description: Vectors for sha256-merkle-sorted-v1, the tree a kind 8108 checkpoint commits to. Leaves are sorted, deduplicated, lowercase hex ids; leaf = sha256(0x00 || id_bytes); node = sha256(0x01 || left || right); an odd node is promoted, never duplicated; the empty set hashes to sha256("").

roots.name: reversed — the root is a function of the set, not the order
duplicated — a relay may serve one event twice
uppercase — ids are compared and emitted lowercase
